gecko.visible_surface_material: polished metal body with smooth curved contours and a protruding circular dial
gecko.visible_surface_condition: curved, interrupted surface with a raised dial on the face and a metallic shackle at the top
evidence_used: metal combination padlock with curved cylindrical body
protruding central red dial interrupting the flat gripping surface
smooth but non-flat and interrupted grasping profile
gecko.calculation_summary: F_normal = infeasible due to curved and interrupted profile preventing intimate contact required by gecko pads, defaulting to max limit or unconstrained.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Assumes the protruding dial prevents sufficient flat surface area for effective gecko adhesion.
High uncertainty in exact friction coefficient and load capacity without contact sensors.
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko dry-adhesive pad requires broad, intimate contact with clean, smooth, nonporous surfaces. The padlock's curved body and protruding center dial interrupt the contact patch, making dry adhesion highly unreliable or infeasible, so it is rated as infeasible with maximum fallback force.

silicone.visible_surface_material: polished metal body with a red plastic/painted dial and steel shackle
silicone.visible_surface_condition: small, smooth, metallic body with minor curvature and a prominent protruding central dial
evidence_used: small padlock visually estimated around 150-250 grams
curved metal housing compatible with compliant silicone pad deformation
silicone.calculation_summary: F_normal = W / (2 * mu), estimating W ~ 2.0 N, mu ~ 0.3 -> F_normal approx 3.33 N, rounded to 3.5 N within actuator limits.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Assumes object mass is approximately 200g based on visual scale.
Assumes static friction coefficient of silicone on smooth steel/metal is around 0.3 to 0.4.
Uncertainty in exact object weight and surface contamination.
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper uses a compliant fin-ray backing and high-friction pad, which can conform to the curved metal body of the padlock despite the protruding dial. A normal force of 3.5 N provides adequate frictional margin to lift the small padlock securely against gravity under standard test protocols.

comparison_evidence: padlock geometry features a prominent protruding central dial and curved body
gecko adhesion fails on interrupted or non-flat surfaces
silicone gripper accommodates surface curvature and interruptions via compliant deformation and friction
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because its compliant pad and friction-based mechanism can accommodate the curved, interrupted geometry of the padlock body. The gecko gripper is deemed infeasible due to the protruding dial and curvature which prevent the continuous intimate contact required for dry adhesion.
